Domestic 5G and 6G Technologies at MWC

At the Mobile World Congress (MWC), to be held in Barcelona on March 2-5, Türk Telekom will introduce 5G and beyond technology solutions developed with domestic ecosystem business partners. The company will present to global technology professionals the projects it carries out together with Argela, i2i Systems, P.I. Works, Plan-S, and Qubitrium.

The solutions to be exhibited as part of the event cover a wide range, from 5G core network architectures to AI-supported network automation, from the integration of non-terrestrial networks (NTN) to quantum security protocols. The relevant technologies aim for mobile networks to transform not only in speed but also into service platforms customizable according to sectoral needs.

Featured Solutions and Partnerships

The main technological developments to stand out at Türk Telekom’s MWC 2026 stand and related partner presentations will be as follows:

  • Argela: CAMARA Application Programming Interfaces (API)-based 5G FPV UAV use cases and real-time data processing solutions in airspace management.
  • i2i Systems: Open standards-compliant, cloud-based, and scalable domestic 5G Core Network (5G Core) architecture.
  • P.I. Works: AI-supported 5G RAN Slice Assurance automation solution that provides real-time performance assurance in network slicing processes.
  • Plan-S: Integration work of Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) systems into 5G-Advanced and 6G mobile network infrastructures.
  • Qubitrium: QKD-based hardware and network solutions aiming to increase end-to-end security in 5G and 6G networks.
